targets.frustum_demand: will the object's bounding box enter the camera frustum; boolean, fields frustum_visible_in_<h>s
targets.occlusion_aware_visible_demand: will the object actually become visible once occlusion is accounted for; TRI-STATE, fields occlusion_visible_in_<h>s, where null means the occlusion state was unknown and never that the object is invisible

resolution_eligibility.rule: an object is eligible only if at least one of its texture identities has generated resolution variants
resolution_eligibility.field: resolution_eligible (per row); resolution_variants and variant_texture_ids are present only for eligible rows

label_semantics: labels cover the window [now, now + horizon]; an object that is not visible now but visible in the window has visible_in_* true and first_visible_time_* > 0
